description: Awarding contracts for the reconstruction of the Vadduvakal Bridge on the Paranthan-Karachchi-Mullaitivu Road (A035)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The bridge number 50/1 on the Paranthan-Karachchi-Mullaitivu road (A035), also known as the Vadduvakal Bridge, is located across the Nandikadal Lagoon in the Mullaitivu District. The bridge, which was last repaired in 2009, is currently in an unsafe condition. Therefore, the Road Development Authority has planned to construct it as a new 2-lane bridge. Bids have been invited for the purpose, through the National Competitive Bidding Procedure. Based on the recommendations made by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the bids received, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to award the contract for the construction of the said bridge, to M/s RR Construction (Pvt) Limited, the substantially responsive lowest bidder, was approved by the Cabinet.
